label: HOT DINOv3-S building footprints (aerial RGB)
description: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's building model: a frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 encoder with a UperNet decoder and three heads (building mask, boundary, signed distance), trained on ~58k OpenAerialMap chips labelled from OpenStreetMap worldwide. Apache-2.0. The signed-distance head is what separates touching buildings.

boundary.meaning: building-edge probability (not used by the pipeline)

distance.meaning: signed distance to the nearest building edge, positive inside, -1..1

source.name: kshitijrajsharma/dinov3-hot-buildings
source.paper: Siméoni et al., DINOv3, arXiv:2508.10104 (encoder); HOT fAIr dinov3_buildings pipeline (decoder, heads, watershed recipe)
source.export: End-to-end ONNX (opset 18) exported by HOT: image[1,3,256,256] float32 in [0,1] normalised with the mean/std above (the graph does not normalise) -> logits[1,3,256,256] raw head output (no activations in the graph): 0 = mask logit, 1 = boundary logit, 2 = signed distance before tanh. The 1.4 GB ViT-L export (dinov3l_buildings.onnx) exists too but exceeds the 1 GB extracted package limit.
